# Blockprint
Capital, code, and chain reactions.
Blockprint is an independent crypto news publication covering markets, protocol upgrades, on-chain data, stablecoins, and digital-asset infrastructure.
It explains the evidence behind token moves and separates durable developments from market noise.
Coverage is written for readers who want clear reporting and practical context.
## Key pages
- Home: https://dailycryptonews.github.io/ — Reverse-chronological crypto news feed.
- About: https://dailycryptonews.github.io/about/ — Editorial mission and information about the editor.
